items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: The bands had been in there, like the Orchid, on Broadway and...where Father Duffy's at.

ctx.x: Yeah, all right. So there's bands all around. There was a whole lot of dancing school bands. New York must have had about fifteen dancing schools. There was three of them on 125th Street, there was about four of them on 57th Street, and along Eighth Avenue between 56th down to around 14th Street, was dancing schools. And you had all these dancing schools, and they had bands in them. The bands had been in there, like the Orchid, on Broadway and...where Father Duffy's at. Is that 46th Street?
